about: Agent host falsifiers: each entry breaks one check (exact text, replaced once), and every named test must then FAIL. Run with falsify.py. expect: caught (all named tests fail), compile_error (the mutation must not build), survives (known survivor, by design). Files are relative to examples/agent-host. command: host (cargo test of the guest) or e2e (run-e2e.sh: the guest in a test Runtime) or selftest (this runner's own self-test, for a change to falsify.py).

retired.CL02: a child host's depth is its child's; CF10 covers it
retired.CL23: chain_stopped no longer looks at a cancelled task; the code is gone
retired.CL25: ask_model's second stopped check is gone; usable_child refuses (CL79)
retired.JF14: the 'idea 2 fields must be empty' rule is what idea 2 replaced; CL43-CL75 cover the new rules
